ca533b9bf396a6.s: The US Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act (CAATSA) was enacted in:
ca533b9bf396a6.x: CAATSA was enacted in 2017; it targets Russia, Iran and North Korea.

ca6b20541c62c8.s: The UN task force set up in 2026 to protect trade through the Strait of Hormuz was led by:
ca6b20541c62c8.x: Jorge Moreira da Silva, Executive Director of UNOPS, led the task force; António Guterres set it up.

cac14317549a1f.s: During the 2026 Hormuz crisis, Indian ships such as Pine Gas and Jag Vasant crossed the strait:
o: under a formal agreement with Iran
after paying up to $2 million per ship
without any formal agreement with Iran or payment
cac14317549a1f.x: India had no formal agreement with Iran and made no payments, though its ships used the route.

cabddd23d36a85.s: The 4th India–Nordic Summit is to be hosted by:
cabddd23d36a85.x: Finland will host the 4th summit; the 1st was in Stockholm (2018), the 2nd in Copenhagen (2022) and the 3rd in Oslo (2026).

ca1060f918fdd4.s: During PM Modi's May 2026 UAE visit, India's share in the UAE's strategic petroleum reserves was raised to:
ca1060f918fdd4.x: India's share in the UAE's strategic petroleum reserves was raised to 30 million barrels.

caa1bc9cb208ac.s: The Universal Postal Union, whose UPU–UPI remittance system was launched with Bhutan in 2026, is headquartered at:
caa1bc9cb208ac.x: The UPU (est. 1874, a UN agency since 1948) is headquartered in Bern, not Geneva.

ca98cfccd24223.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Vietnam President To Lam's May 2026 visit to India?
o: He first prayed at the Mahabodhi Temple, Bodh Gaya
India and Vietnam set a trade target of $30 billion by 2030
He was welcomed at Rashtrapati Bhavan
ca98cfccd24223.x: The trade target set is $25 billion by 2030, not $30 billion.

cabafc95a367c4.s: The Aarogya Maitri BHISHM Cube facility set up by India in Jamaica was guided by:
cabafc95a367c4.x: The NSCS guided the initiative and the MEA coordinated it; CARICOM is the regional grouping with which ties were strengthened.

ca59fb88c28cb0.s: Which of the following is correct about the European Political Community (EPC)?
o: It is an institution of the European Union
It is not an institution of the European Union
Its members are only EU member states
Canada is a founding member of it
ca59fb88c28cb0.x: The EPC is not an EU institution; it also includes non-EU states like the UK and Norway, and Canada first took part only in 2026.

cad2fcfd991b62.s: India and Canada have set a bilateral trade target of US$50 billion by:
cad2fcfd991b62.x: The target is US$50 billion by 2030; CEPA is to be concluded by end-2026.

cae6e9b46539f7.s: The India–South Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) has been in force since:
cae6e9b46539f7.x: The India–South Korea CEPA has been in force since 2010; the two sides agreed to upgrade it.

ca94690b88edd8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the India–Austria talks of April 2026?
o: The talks were held in Vienna
They focused on semiconductors, quantum technology and biotechnology
An MoU was signed between IIT Delhi and Montan University
Nursing opportunities and the Working Holiday Programme were discussed
ca94690b88edd8.x: PM Modi and Chancellor Christian Stocker held the talks in New Delhi on 16 April 2026, not in Vienna.

caab86b7e900e3.s: India aims to raise its nuclear power capacity from 9 GW to 100 GW by:
caab86b7e900e3.x: The target is 100 GW by 2047; India's uranium import dependence is over 70%.

ca43e24edcbbee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the sinking of IRIS Dena and UNCLOS?
o: IRIS Dena sank outside Sri Lanka's 12 nm territorial sea
IRIS Dena sank within Sri Lanka's Search and Rescue region
UNCLOS was adopted at Montego Bay, Jamaica
ca43e24edcbbee.x: UNCLOS was adopted on 10 December 1982 but came into force only on 16 November 1994.

nb3841547fa3.s: The India-assisted Mangdechhu hydro project in Bhutan, commissioned in 2019, has a capacity of:
nb3841547fa3.x: Mangdechhu is 720 MW (2019); Punatsangchhu-I is the 1,200 MW project.

ca1928f21c5afe.s: India maintains large strategic reserves only for:
ca1928f21c5afe.x: India has strategic reserves only for crude; it has no large reserves for LPG or LNG.

ca413910e2a38f.s: Which of the following has NOT ratified UNCLOS?
ca413910e2a38f.x: India and the EU are parties to UNCLOS, whereas the United States has not ratified it.

ca1830df1819b6.s: Russian Culture Minister Olga Lyubimova attended WAVES 2025, held in May 2025 at:
ca1830df1819b6.x: Olga Lyubimova attended WAVES 2025 in Mumbai in May 2025.

cad5684e19c95e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 'Shadbhujii Coalition'?
o: It includes Greece and Cyprus along with India
IMEC was announced at the 2023 G20
It was announced by Israel's President Isaac Herzog
cad5684e19c95e.x: The coalition was announced by PM Benjamin Netanyahu, not President Isaac Herzog.

ca9a1354c6cb5f.s: India and Canada have set a CEPA target of USD 70 billion by:
ca9a1354c6cb5f.x: The India–Canada CEPA target is USD 70 billion by 2030.

ca80d830b94606.s: Mark Carney became Prime Minister of Canada in:
ca80d830b94606.x: Carney became PM in March 2025 after Justin Trudeau stepped down in January 2025.

ca8512be4f8f25.s: India's $175 million aid package to Seychelles was linked to:
ca8512be4f8f25.x: The Seychelles package was linked to Vision MAHASAGAR, which extends SAGAR (2015).

ca815803716653.s: The India–UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) came into force in:
ca815803716653.x: The CEPA came into force in 2022; the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership dates to 2017.

cac0211880d2c2.s: Which of the following is a Partner, not a Guest, in the US-led PAX SILICA initiative?
cac0211880d2c2.x: The UK and Japan are Partners; Taiwan, Canada and the EU are Guests.

ca870435f32768.s: José María Balkazar of Peru Libre became Peru's president after being elected by:
ca870435f32768.x: Balkazar was elected by Peru's 130-member Congress.

ca0d2b2fd69256.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Weimar Triangle?
o: It consists of France, Germany and Poland
It was established on 29 August 1991 at Weimar
It has a formal institutional structure
S. Jaishankar's meeting with it was India's first-ever engagement
ca0d2b2fd69256.x: The Weimar Triangle has no formal institutional structure.

ca6617fb3b8d79.s: After PM Modi's visit to Israel, Israel targeted 50,000 more Indian workers over a period of:
ca6617fb3b8d79.x: The target of 50,000 more Indian workers is for five years, not ten.

ca80dd45293d99.s: In the February 2026 Japanese election, the LDP won how many of the 465 seats?
ca80dd45293d99.x: The LDP won 271 of 465 seats (majority mark 261); Thailand's Bhumjaithai won 194 of 500.

ca1f09ce13bc2f.s: The first exchange of lists of nuclear installations between India and Pakistan took place on:
ca1f09ce13bc2f.x: The agreement was signed on 31 December 1988; the first exchange took place on 1 January 1992.

ca6dc4410cd8d7.s: At the India–Fiji agriculture talks of 9 January 2026, the Agriculture MoU was extended by:
ca6dc4410cd8d7.x: The MoU was extended by five years and a Joint Working Group was to be set up.

caf8ef66eb74c1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Wangchhu Hydroelectric Project in Bhutan?
o: The Wangchu is called Raidak in India
It supplies winter power to India
The Wangchu is a tributary of the Brahmaputra
caf8ef66eb74c1.x: It is reversed: winter power goes to Bhutan and the summer surplus to India.

caa04476a38cfd.s: In the Operation Sindoor outreach of May 2025, AP MP Daggubati Purandeswari was in the delegation led by:
caa04476a38cfd.x: Purandeswari was in Ravi Shankar Prasad's delegation; Lavu Sri Krishna Devarayalu went with Supriya Sule and GM Harish Balayogi with Shashi Tharoor.

cac5d25cdc54df.s: The comprehensive India–UK trade deal was signed in:
cac5d25cdc54df.x: The deal was signed in July 2025; the FTA was still under implementation talks during Starmer's visit.

caa60fe8eaa54c.s: Under the 2025 US pharmaceutical tariff, imports from the EU and Japan were capped at:
caa60fe8eaa54c.x: The EU and Japan were capped at 15%; branded and patented imports otherwise faced 100%.

ca834043be52fc.s: Which Iranian site, struck in June 2025, was Iran's main uranium enrichment centre?
ca834043be52fc.x: Natanz was the main enrichment centre; Fordow was the underground facility under a mountain near Qom.

ca5745bb832fb9.s: In June 2025, Iran retaliated by striking the US Al-Udeid Air Base in:
ca5745bb832fb9.x: Iran struck Al-Udeid Air Base in Qatar with advance notice; the ceasefire was announced by Trump.

caa555e3b0fa76.s: Which Article of the UN Charter bars the use of force?
caa555e3b0fa76.x: Article 2 of the UN Charter bars the use of force.

cafcbcea173ccb.s: After the Jaishankar–Muttaqi meeting in 2025, India's technical mission in Kabul was upgraded to:
o: a full embassy headed by a Charge d'Affaires
a full embassy headed by an Ambassador
cafcbcea173ccb.x: The mission became a full embassy headed by a Charge d'Affaires; India still does not formally recognise the Taliban.

ca41d2746fde1c.s: Which of the following is an Indian project in Afghanistan?
ca41d2746fde1c.x: The Zaranj–Delaram Highway and the Salma Dam are separate Indian projects in Afghanistan.

ca958ed6516a5a.s: During 1996–2001, India had no ties with the Taliban and backed:
ca958ed6516a5a.x: In 1996–2001 India backed the Northern Alliance; it still does not formally recognise the Taliban regime.

ca50f2dc3b2b9a.s: In the Afghanistan–Pakistan context, PTM stands for:
ca50f2dc3b2b9a.x: PTM is the Pashtun Tahafuz Movement; TTP is Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan.

caf5c09025cbeb.s: Under the 2025 India–Japan Annual Summit outcomes, how many Indians were to be trained in Japan?
caf5c09025cbeb.x: The training target is 50,000 Indians; India runs a trade deficit with Japan.

cac96e07fdd069.s: Unlike a treaty, the US executive order 'Assuring the Security of the State of Qatar':
o: can be repealed by a future president
is legally binding on future presidents
cac96e07fdd069.x: As an executive order and not a treaty, it needed no Senate approval and can be repealed by a future president.

ca88c5e8119261.s: The Galwan clash between India and China took place in:
ca88c5e8119261.x: Galwan occurred in 2020; the India–China détente came post-Tianjin in 2025.

ca8d4bf47305f8.s: The UN snapback sanctions reimposed on Iran in 2025 ban uranium enrichment:
ca8d4bf47305f8.x: The snapback measures include a ban on enrichment at any level, besides asset freezes, travel bans and an arms embargo.

caf57509fd5c81.s: The Sugauli Treaty, at the root of the India–Nepal Lipulekh dispute, was concluded in:
caf57509fd5c81.x: The Sugauli Treaty dates to 1815; the dispute is about the origin of the Mahakali River.

cad37bf14306c3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the regional fallout of Operation Sindoor?
o: India treats Kashmir as a bilateral matter
The ceasefire was announced by US President Donald Trump
China reportedly backed India, creating a two-front threat for Pakistan
Pakistan's army chief is Field Marshal Asim Munir
cad37bf14306c3.x: China reportedly backed Pakistan, raising a two-front threat for India, not the reverse.

cab44008498d92.s: The Teesta river originates in Tso Lhamo Lake in:
cab44008498d92.x: The Teesta rises in Tso Lhamo Lake in Sikkim, not Bangladesh.

ca97acda3941e1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India–Israel economic relations?
o: Annual India–Israel trade is about USD 40 billion
FTA talks are the next step after the BIT
The BIT was signed in New Delhi on 8 September 2025
Israel is the first OECD member to sign a BIT under India's new framework
ca97acda3941e1.x: Annual India–Israel trade is about USD 4 billion, not 40 billion.

new.s: Exercise Lamitiye 2026 (11th edition, tri-services) was held between India and:
new.x: Lamitiye 2026 was the 11th India–Seychelles exercise, at the Seychelles Defence Academy.

new.s: PRAGATI 2026, the Indian Army's counter-terrorism exercise with 12 friendly nations, was held at:
new.x: PRAGATI 2026 began on 20 May 2026 at Umroi, Meghalaya – the first such multilateral exercise hosted by the Indian Army.

new.s: Exercise Dustlik 2026 (7th edition) is an Army exercise between India and:
new.x: Dustlik is the India–Uzbekistan Army exercise; its 7th edition was held at Namangan, Uzbekistan.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: Lamitiye 2026 was the 11th edition; the 7th edition in 2026 was Dustlik (India–Uzbekistan).

new.s: In December 2025, the US approved an arms package for Taiwan, including HIMARS and Javelin, worth about:
new.x: The US approved about $11.1 billion of arms for Taiwan; China opposes it under the One-China Principle.

new.s: Who is the President of South Korea with whom PM Modi set a USD 50 billion trade target for 2030?
new.x: Lee Jae Myung is South Korea's President; Pham Minh Chinh is Vietnam's PM and Prabowo Subianto Indonesia's President.

new.s: Who is the Prime Minister of Sri Lanka, met by Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan in April 2026?
new.x: Harini Amarasuriya is Sri Lanka's PM; Anura Kumara Dissanayake is its President.

new.s: Which of the following country–leader pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: Mojtaba Khamenei is Iran's Supreme Leader; Iran's President is Masoud Pezeshkian.

new.s: India's Act East Policy, under which Vietnam is called a key partner, was launched in:
new.x: The Act East Policy was launched in 2014; Modi called Vietnam a key partner in it.

new.s: During its President's May 2026 state visit, which country did PM Modi call a key partner in the Act East Policy?
new.x: Modi called Vietnam a key partner in the Act East Policy during President To Lam's visit.

new.s: India's relationship with Vietnam is termed:
o: Green Technology and Innovation Strategic Partnership
new.x: India–Vietnam ties are an Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership; Special Strategic Partnership is India–Italy.

new.s: To implement the 2025–2029 Joint Strategic Action Plan, India and Italy set up a:
new.x: A permanent Foreign Ministers' mechanism implements the India–Italy 2025–2029 Joint Strategic Action Plan.

new.s: Which dialogue was among the outcomes of the India–South Korea summit with President Lee Jae Myung?
new.x: The India–South Korea package included an economic security dialogue; Inter-Governmental Consultations is the India–Germany mechanism.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a member of EFTA, with which India has the TEPA?
new.x: EFTA comprises Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland; Sweden is not a member.

new.s: The India–EFTA TEPA targets investment of US$100 billion and the creation of:
new.x: The TEPA targets US$100 billion investment and 1 million jobs.

new.s: Which port is described as the rival project to India-backed Chabahar?
new.x: Pakistan's Gwadar is the rival to Chabahar, which lies on the Gulf of Oman.

new.s: The Shahid Beheshti terminal at Chabahar is run by India under a 10-year agreement signed in May 2024 through:
new.x: India Ports Global Limited (IPGL) runs the Shahid Beheshti terminal under a 10-year agreement of May 2024.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Chabahar:
1. It lies on the Gulf of Oman, outside the Persian Gulf.
2. It is Iran's only oceanic port.
3. The INSTC linked to it extends to Southeast Asia.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the 7,200 km INSTC links India, Iran, Russia, Central Asia and Europe, not Southeast Asia.

new.s: In March 2026, Canada's status in the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) became:
new.x: Canada became a Dialogue Partner of IORA in March 2026.

new.s: Tummalapalle, one of the world's largest uranium reserves, is located in:
new.x: Tummalapalle is in Andhra Pradesh, not Jharkhand; Narwapahar and Bhatin are in Jharkhand.

new.s: With the Rooppur plant, Bangladesh became the ____ country to use nuclear power.
new.x: Bangladesh became the 33rd country to use nuclear power with the 2 × 1,200 MW Rooppur plant.

new.s: The BHISHM Cube set up by India in Jamaica can treat:
new.x: The BHISHM Cube, the world's first portable modular hospital, has 72 mini-cubes and treats 200 patients for 48 hours.

new.s: Which earlier operations were India's evacuations of its citizens from West Asia?
o: Operation Epic Fury and Lion's Roar
True Promise 4 and Ghazab Lil Haq
new.x: Operation Rahat and Operation Ajay were India's past evacuations; the others are military operations of the US, Israel, Iran or Pakistan.

new.s: Under Iran's toll-booth system in the Strait of Hormuz, ships were charged up to:
new.x: Iran charged up to $2 million per ship, some reportedly in yuan; traffic fell from ~130 to 3–4 ships a day.

new.s: NGRI, Hyderabad signed an MoU with Emerald Geomodelling during PM Modi's May 2026 visit to:
new.x: The NGRI–Emerald Geomodelling MoU was among 12 S&T agreements signed with Norway.

new.s: The 13th edition of the multilateral naval exercise MILAN (February 2026) was hosted at:
new.x: MILAN 2026 was held at Visakhapatnam on 15–25 February 2026 along with the International Fleet Review.

new.s: Exercise Dharma Guardian 2026, held at Chaubattia in Uttarakhand, is an Army exercise between India and:
new.x: Dharma Guardian is the India–Japan Army exercise; INDRA is the India–Russia series.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: Zapad-2025 was hosted by Russia; India only took part in it.

new.s: India and Russia's military-technical cooperation agreement covers the period:
new.x: The India–Russia military-technical cooperation agreement covers 2021–2031.

new.s: Which of the following is a joint India–Russia development rather than a purchase or licence build?
new.x: BrahMos is jointly developed by DRDO and NPO Mashinostroyeniya; S-400 and INS Vikramaditya are purchases and Su-30MKI is licence-built by HAL.

new.s: Of the five S-400 Triumf regiments India purchased from Russia, how many had been delivered?
new.x: India bought 5 S-400 regiments, of which 3 have been delivered.

new.s: The AK-203 rifles under India–Russia cooperation are made by:
new.x: AK-203 is made by Indo-Russia Rifles Pvt Ltd; HAL licence-builds the Su-30MKI.

new.s: MAHASAGAR, which extends SAGAR to the Global South and the Indo-Pacific, was announced in:
new.x: SAGAR dates to 2015; MAHASAGAR (2025) extends it to the Global South and Indo-Pacific.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about SAGAR:
1. It was announced in 2015.
2. It projects India as a net security provider in the Indian Ocean Region.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region, 2015) casts India as net security provider in the IOR.

new.s: The I2U2 grouping consists of India, Israel, the USA and:
new.x: I2U2 = India, Israel, UAE and USA.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a member of the G7?
new.x: The G7 is Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, UK and US; Russia was in the G8 from 1998.

new.s: Annual India–Russia summits began with which development?
o: 1971 Treaty of Peace, Friendship and Cooperation
new.x: Annual summits began with the 2000 Declaration on Strategic Partnership; the 2010 upgrade was to a Special and Privileged one.

new.s: Under the February 2026 India–US trade deal, India's GSP benefits, withdrawn in 2019, were:
new.x: The deal did not restore GSP; the US tariff on India is now 18%, not zero.

new.s: India–US 'Mission 500' aims at bilateral trade of USD 500 billion by:
new.x: Mission 500 targets USD 500 billion of India–US trade by 2030.

new.s: Hardeep Nijjar, whose killing triggered the 2023 India–Canada crisis, was killed in which Canadian province?
new.x: The Nijjar killing (June 2023) took place in British Columbia, not Ontario.

new.s: In the joint venture for Bhutan's Wangchhu project, Druk Green Power holds:
new.x: The JV is Druk Green Power 51% and Adani Power 49%.

new.s: Andrey Gurov was appointed interim Prime Minister of which country?
new.x: Andrey Gurov, Deputy Governor of the Bulgarian National Bank, was appointed Bulgaria's interim PM by President Iliana Lotova.

new.s: Operation Swadesh (January 2026) was India's evacuation of its nationals from:
new.x: Operation Swadesh evacuated Indians from Iran amid anti-government protests.

new.s: The US-led exercise Pacific Angel-25 was held in 2025 at:
new.x: Pacific Angel-25 and Tiger Lightning-2025 were held at Chittagong, Bangladesh.

new.s: AUSINDEX is an India–Australia exercise of which service?
new.x: AUSINDEX is the naval exercise; AUSTRAHIND is the Army exercise.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: Talisman Sabre is an Australia-led multilateral exercise, not India-hosted.

new.s: During Operation Sindoor, India's S-400, used in combat for the first time, downed a Pakistani aircraft at a range of:
new.x: The S-400 downed a Pakistani aircraft at 314 km in its first combat use.

new.s: India's first ASRAAM assembly and testing facility, under UK–India defence ties, is at:
new.x: India's first ASRAAM assembly and testing facility is in Hyderabad.

new.s: Katchatheevu, an uninhabited islet in the Palk Strait, was placed under Sri Lanka by the India–Sri Lanka Maritime Boundary Treaty of:
new.x: The 1974 Maritime Boundary Treaty placed Katchatheevu under Sri Lanka.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about India's foreign policy:
1. S. Jaishankar described strategic autonomy as multi-alignment, not bloc alignment.
2. The Non-Aligned Movement, its root, means neutrality.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only 1 is correct: NAM (Belgrade, 1961) is not neutrality.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Durand Line:
1. It was drawn by the British in 1893.
2. It has been formally recognised by Afghanistan.
3. It is about 2,611 km long.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; Afghanistan has never recognised the Durand Line.

new.s: Which of the following countries was a party to the 2015 JCPOA with Iran as part of the P5+1?
new.x: The P5+1 was the US, UK, France, Russia, China and Germany.

new.s: India's Security and Defence Partnership with the EU is the EU's ____ such partnership in Asia.
new.x: It is the EU's 3rd in Asia, after Japan and South Korea.

new.s: The inaugural Australia–India Defence Ministers' Dialogue marked five years of the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, established in:
new.x: The Comprehensive Strategic Partnership dates to 2020; the dialogue in Canberra (9 Oct 2025) marked five years.

new.s: Rajnath Singh announced a new Defence Wing at the Indian Embassy in:
new.x: A Defence Wing at the Indian Embassy in Rabat was announced with the India–Morocco Defence MoU.

new.s: The Kokrajhar–Gelephu cross-border rail line between India and Bhutan is about:
new.x: Kokrajhar–Gelephu is 69 km; Banarhat–Samtse is 20 km; both are fully funded by India.

new.s: India's development investment in Afghanistan since 2001 has been over:
new.x: India has invested over USD 3 billion in Afghanistan's development since 2001.

new.s: Which Shinkansen series is to be used for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail under India–Japan ties?
new.x: The 2025 summit outcomes named the E10 series Shinkansen for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad HSR.

new.s: Qatar has been a Major Non-NATO Ally of the United States since:
new.x: Qatar has been an MNNA since 2022 and hosts Al-Udeid, the largest US base in the Middle East.

new.s: From 21 May 2025, how many multi-party delegations did India send abroad on cross-border terrorism after Operation Sindoor?
new.x: Seven multi-party delegations went to world capitals from 21 May 2025.

new.s: Under the 2011 draft Teesta water-sharing arrangement, India's share was:
new.x: The 2011 draft gave India 42.5% and Bangladesh 37.5%.
